name: HttpPost
description: Performs a POST request for game:HttpPost(...) or game:HttpPostAsync(...) and returns the response body string or a request error string.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Method-call self value. Use game:HttpPost(...) or game:HttpPostAsync(...).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional request body. Defaults to an empty string.

parameters.name: contentTypeOrCompatibility
parameters.description: Normally the content type string. A number uses legacy timeout mode, and a boolean uses legacy compression mode.

parameters.name: headersOrContentType
parameters.description: Optional headers table in the normal call shape, or optional content type string in legacy mode.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional headers table used only in legacy mode.
